name: Chocontá (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal seal of Chocontá (the arms within a ring inscribed LEAL Y NOBLE VILLA DE SANTIAGO DE CHOCONTA).
history: Municipal flag of Chocontá, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Chocontá seal — arms within a ring inscribed LEAL Y NOBLE VILLA DE SANTIAGO DE CHOCONTA
